text.p: Results on the 10th day of the US$7.6 million Australian Open tennis tournment at Melbourne Park on Tuesday (prefix denotes seeding):
1-Todd Woodbridge (Australia) and Mark Woodforde (Australia) beat Martin Damm (Czech Republic) and Andrei Olhovskiy (Russia) 6-3 6-3 6-3
11-Rick Leach (U.S.) and Jonathan Stark (U.S.) beat 4-Ellis Ferreira (South Africa) and Patrick Galbraith (U.S.) 7-5 2-6 6-4 7-6 (7-5)
4-Martina Hingis (Switzerland) and Natasha Zvereva (Belarus) beat Virginia Ruano-Pascual (Spain) and Paola Suarez (Argentina) 6-3 6-2
3-Lindsay Davenport (U.S.) and Lisa Raymond (U.S.) beat 12-Conchita Martinez (Spain) and Patricia Tarabini (Argentina) 6-4 7-6 (7-2)
2-Larisa Neiland (Latvia) and Helena Sukova (Czech Republic) beat 13-Naoko Kijimuta (Japan) and Nana Miyagi (Japan) 6-2 6-3
1-Gigi Fernandez (U.S.) and Arantxa Sanchez Vicario (Spain) beat 5-Nicole Arendt (U.S.) and Manon Bollegraf (Netherlands) 6-4 7-5
